messages.subject: RapidCure technology transfer - kickoff
messages.plaintextBody:
Hannah,

Following execution, here's the plan for the Schedule 2 transfer (see Project_Skylark_TechnologyTransferPlan in the data room). Phase 1 documentation handover this week, on-site walkthrough at Cranfield the week of 2 December, and a witnessed first-article cure trial by 14 December. The 40 free technical-assistance days run through Year 1.

Dr Priya Saxena
Director of Quality, Halstead Aerospace
